versions.grouping_at_time: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop
versions.title_at_revision: Cargo and payload CG movement during aerial delivery and dynamic operations
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle accounts for cargo and payload weight shifts during airdrops and external load operations, ensuring that the air vehicle’s CG always remains within published limits. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Ensure stability and control analyses are conducted to show air vehicle CG can be maintained during all flight phases. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct high fidelity 6-DOF flying quality simulations of taxi, takeoff, climb, cruise, descent, approach, landing, and dynamic aerial delivery, including transients.
  (2) Simulate the dynamic forces of airdrop on air vehicle weight and balance during airdrop operations.
